rule: A grey (5) wall row and wall column enclose a top-left legend box. The box holds two or more small polyominoes, each with a distinct colour and a distinct free form. Every green (3) shape outside the box is recoloured with the colour of the legend shape that has the same form up to rotation and reflection. All other cells are unchanged.
scope: Legend-based recolouring of free polyomino classes; variable compact and large layouts, equal-area distractor classes, rotations and labelled chiral reflection extensions.

Independent painted-input matcher passed 1240 unique scenes, including 927 equal-area class sets and 609 scenes needing reflection.

Malformed explicit lists and cells now consistently reject with ValueError.
Final adversarial parameter cases: 29 successful trials and 10 correctly rejected trials; no expectation overrides.

authored_scope: Random scenes support grids of 6-30 per side. Grids larger than the fixtures' 18 are synthetic extensions. Other sampled variables: the wall row (2-5), the wall column (3-28), 2-5 legend shapes drawn from all 20 free polyominoes of 2-5 cells, the legend orientations and colours, forced shared cell counts (as in fixture pair 3), and 8-separated green copies at fixture-like density. Rotations-only and mirror-including scenes are both supported. Mirror scenes guarantee at least one mirrored copy of a chiral legend form, which is a synthetic extension because the fixtures only show achiral forms. Deliberately not supported: the legend in a corner other than top-left, non-grey walls, green shapes with no matching legend form (the reference's size fallback is never exercised), touching or overlapping greens, legend shapes stacked vertically, and legend shapes larger than 5 cells in random mode. Explicit mode accepts any 4-connected legend shapes and reconstructs all four canonical fixtures.
authored_constraints: Legend colours are distinct and never 0, 3 or 5.
Legend forms are pairwise distinct under the 8 dihedral transforms.
Legend shapes lie strictly inside the box (r < wall_row, c < wall_col) and are not 8-adjacent to each other.
Every green shape has exactly the free form of one legend shape, and every legend form appears at least once among the greens.
Green shapes never enter the box (no cell with r <= wall_row and c <= wall_col) and are pairwise 8-separated, so 4- and 8-connectivity agree.
reflections=False: no green is a mirror-only copy. reflections=True: at least one green is a mirror copy of a chiral legend form.
shared_size=True: two legend shapes share a cell count. shared_size=False: all legend cell counts differ.
Random mode rejects up front any request whose box cannot fit the requested legend; feasibility is decided by an exact search over the 20 enumerated forms.
All retry loops are bounded (200 scene attempts, 100 placement tries per shape, 60 size draws plus a deterministic pruned search).
